name: VSCodium
description: The open-source VS Code editor in your browser, no remote desktop needed.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Your VSCodium home folder, with editor settings, extensions, SSH keys (.ssh), your projects and connection-token.txt.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: VSCodium in your browser, published on host as 6160

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CONNECTION_TOKEN
variables.description: The secret you add to the address (?tkn=...) to open VSCodium. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. Find it in /mnt/cache/appdata/vscodium/connection-token.txt (open it with the Files app) or in the app log. Or type your own here.
